name.en: Omega Vidolium the Power Patron of Heaven's End
name.ja: <ruby>終<rt>しゅう</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt>てん</rt></ruby><ruby>獄<rt>ごく</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt>しん</rt></ruby><ruby>Ω<rt>オメガ</rt></ruby>ヴィードリウム

text.en:
3 monsters Special Summoned from the Extra Deck with 3000 or more ATK
Must first be Fusion Summoned. Unaffected by card effects, except "Power Patron" cards'. When your opponent activates a monster effect while they control 2 or more monsters with the same Type as that monster (Quick Effect): You can banish (face-down) the top 3 cards of your Deck; negate the activation, and if you do, banish that monster face-down. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Place this card in your Pendulum Zone.
text.zh-CN:
被从额外牌组特殊召唤的攻击力3000以上的怪兽×3
此卡从额外牌组仅可通过融合召唤来特殊召唤。①：此卡只要存在于怪兽区域，不受“狱神”卡以外的卡的效果影响。②：对手发动怪兽的效果时，如果对手场上存在2只以上与该怪兽相同种族的怪兽，则从牌组上面将3张卡以里侧除外可以发动。将该发动无效并以里侧除外。③：在自己的准备阶段发动。将此卡放在自己的灵摆区域。

pendulum_effect.en: If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can return this card to the Extra Deck, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from either field, including a "Power Patron" monster you control.
pendulum_effect.zh-CN: ①：怪兽被从额外牌组特殊召唤的情况下可以发动。将此卡放回额外牌组。然后，可将包含自己场上的“狱神”怪兽在内的、自己・对手场上的怪兽作为融合素材，将1只融合怪兽融合召唤。

materials: 3 monsters Special Summoned from the Extra Deck with 3000 or more ATK
